title: Reservoir Flood Mitigation
intro: An improved modelling framework for the simulation, optimisation and operation of small and medium reservoirs for flood mitigation.

cards.title: Chennai Floods — 2015
cards.desc: Chembarambakkam reservoir overflow triggered catastrophic urban flooding across Chennai, highlighting the need for real-time reservoir operation.

cards.title: Pune Floods — 2024
cards.desc: Khadakwasla Dam releases caused severe downstream flooding in Pune, demonstrating the critical role of optimised dam operation.

keyMessage: ℹ Need for flood control of small and medium reservoirs used for conservation purpose located just upstream of Indian cities.
